notes: hour/minute_of_day/day_of_week/is_weekend are computed server-side from the current timestamp when a citizen joins the queue. patients_in_system and arrivals_last_60min are live queue-load figures queue-service must supply at call time (they aren't derivable from a clock). Doctor Type/Financial Class are one-hot encoded inside the pipeline itself, with unknown categories at inference handled by OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore').
